notes.title: Major Content Update Available！
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42550418/ad5b064506929af35c99b9ce8a5d65fdc340d75d.png

This major update is free for everyone! All players who already own the base game (not prologue) will receive all content in this update free of charge!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1955830/

This major update contains the following new content:

New Stages
The adventure continues!  Following in the Hero of Ice's footsteps, we've created 3 brand new stages with distinct styles, in which you will take on powerful new bosses! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42550418/179aed56cce10a555433ff2ccbcae78518a0fba8.png
Included in this update is also a special stagewith gameplay unlike any of the stages before.

New Battles
Every journey has its obstacles!  The Hero of Ice will encounter 2 new bosses. They pack a punch, and they're both popular Touhou characters. Players will need to grasp even more combat techniques to stand a chance at defeating them!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42550418/15f6b58710732e3cccc4ee80290cb2b38952b11a.png
Furthermore, the player will have to go up against the game's first ever giant boss.

New Items
Prepare for battle!  The Hero of Ice will obtain 2 new spell cards and 6 new items. With these new tools in your arsenal, you'll be able to better take on the new challenges!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42550418/c92cfeb6f357ee851e2d6b01a1e9fd6aea778ad1.png

And More...!!!

 A new area in the Bunny Train  the Bunny Lounge  is now available.
 The much-awaited feature of rebinding controller buttons is now live. You can now rebind controller buttons.
 Minigames separate from the main story are now in development with a release planned for November.

→Join our discord←

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42550418/fa18344ba4d31c5e468c32aef929d6702ef6e220.png

notes.title: New playtesting available & Update Teaser
notes.notes:
Playtesting of Touhou Hero of Ice Fairy (not prologue)
 NOW AVAILABLE!!!    

All players who have purchased the game can access the new content for... FREE!!!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1955830/

(Note: the playtest version will NOT include the English translation. Playtesting of the English translation will begin on October 12)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42550418/e0efafbb4fd5a06a02934b88a9e8a8d7d7ab88ae.png

How to Access New Content  
1. In your Steam library, right-click the game and click on "properties" in the dropdown menu.
2. Click on "Betas" in the left panel.
3. Simply select "test - Ocotober Update" and wait for it to download!


!!!To avoid any progress being lost, please backup your save files before playing this version!!!
 


Supporter Pack
The Supporter pack will be updated on October 14. Included are brand new illustrations, artwork and songs. Players who have already purchased the Supporter Pack will receive all the new content for free!

Feedback
If you encounter any issues during playtesting or have any suggestions, feel free to send us an email or give feedback in our official Discord server. Your contributions will allow us to continue improving the game!

notes.title: 18,000 Copies sold! English Version Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Since its release in February 25, our game—Touhou Hero of Ice Fairy—has managed to break 18k sales in just one month !

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1955830/

This comes as a big shock to us since it wildly surpassed our original expectations. Back in early 2021, I decided to make a no micro-dodging game out of spite since I was suffering from Touhou Hidden Star in Four Seasons's unique problem of not being able to properly see the bullets. I honestly never thought our game'd achieve such results two years down the line. It's thanks to everyone's continued support that we could get to this point. 

Without everyone, we—and by extension Touhou Hero of Ice Fairy—wouldn't be where we are today, and for that we couldn't thank you enough!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323069/a96454a6e7f013b44c134a45c6286aba8406918e.png

English Version Coming Soon
Currently, we're dedicating our time to finishing the game's English version, with a release slated for April 12. If you're interested in helping us test the English version, please join our Discord server. The first round of testing will commence on the first week of April.

→Click here to join our Discord server←

Furthermore, in April we'll also be releasing a feature to replay past story events as well as a mode for players who aren't great at action games, in addition to some new items and spell cards.

We understand that there are high expectations for what comes next in the game, and we promise we'll do our best to give everyone the full Touhou Hero of Ice Fairy experience!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41323069/8bdf20abf5ee9fd445a43d5135a0654ced1cb7cc.png

notes.notes:

Fixes

 Fixed an issue where the player experienced abnormal control with controller.

Optimization

 Now press F1 can open the teaching pop-up window, and you can see all the teaching content.
